name: The Ministry
desc:
The Ministry is a group of mysterious users of Shadowcast who seek to cause Great Drownings in order to achieve Godhood. They are led by the Nine Prophets, with the First Prophet being the strongest mortal alive, the Second Prophet being the one who pioneered Bloodrend and spread it to their followers in the form of an Oath, and the Fourth, [Zi'eer](entity:the_lord_regent), being the current Lord Regent of Etrea. They have some sort of hostility against [The Children of Navae](faction:the_children_of_navae) and desire to clear them out of [Summer Isle](location:summer_isle), presumably due to The Children of Navae's allegiance with a Celestial, Navae, while the Ministry seeks the favor of the Drowned Gods. This is a rather one-sided rivalry.

The exact time of their founding is unclear, but by 1272, the original incarnation of the Ministry who had fought to conquer [Minityrsa](location:minityrsa) were considered ancient.

They are responsible for the drowning of [Celtor](location:the_city_of_the_drowned). The city was drowned as an offering to [Yun'Shul](entity:yunshul_keeper_of_hearts), though they did not care for the surprise gift and did not give the Ministry any reward for it.

They enjoy recruiting people to kill others, sometimes to kill specific individuals, sometimes just to kill random people.

They are refered to as originating from the [Western Luminant](location:luminants).
additional_info:
-   Ministry [enemies](entity:ministry_necromancer) all use a Krulian Knife, besides the Ministry Enforcer, [Nostor](entity:nostor_master_of_shadow), [Ministry Agent](entity:ministry_agent), [Chaser](entity:chaser_scholar_of_the_crimson_contract) and Ministry Heartbleeders.
-   The Ministry's emblem appears as a polar opposite to Lost Celtor, especially being associated in [drowning the latter's capital](faction:lost_celtor) as well as the "arrow" motifs.
